cohort: 118 nulliparous women with endometriosis and 1,690 nulliparous controls
finding: Nulliparous women with endometriosis, particularly deep endometriosis, had a higher incidence of vacuum delivery, cesarean section, and placenta previa compared to unaffected women, while neonatal outcomes remained similar.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis had a higher incidence of cesarean section compared to unaffected women.
